description: Search public openings on Foundaree: jobs, freelance work, internships, projects, co-founder and advisory roles. Use it when the user is looking for work or a role ("React jobs in Bengaluru", "a co-founder role in fintech", "internships in design"), or asks what a company is hiring for. Matches the title, description, city and skills. Only open listings are returned unless `includeClosed` is true. Returns JSON with `items` (each: `username`, `title`, `type`, `companyUsername`, `location`, `description`, `skills`, `status`, `listingUrl`, `companyUrl`) and `total`. People apply on the listing page on Foundaree; this tool does not apply for anyone. Foundaree is new, so there may be few or none: say so rather than guessing.

includeClosed.description: Also return listings that are closed. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Role, skill, kind of work or city, e.g. "React developer Bengaluru"

name: search_opportunities
title: Search jobs and openings
